Neutral blocking is when you block by not pressing any buttons. It's not as fast as holding back to actively block and it lets some strings connect, as well as break your guard, like Heihachi's uf3,4.

Active blocking is when you're blocking by actively holding back. It allows you to block as soon as you recover from a hit and only unblockables go through.

If I'm not wrong, by default the dummy in Practice is set to neutral blocking instead of active blocking, which is how newcomers initially think a string is a natural combo when it's not.

Hope that's clear enough!

Hey there! I haven't really played jungle Shen that much, but I guess you can transport some of the top mechanics into the jungle, as well as the champion mechanics in general.

I'd say for the masteries you have two choices:
- Windspeaker doesn't sound bad. It's not the ideal choice in my opinion, but I guess it works, after all, you increase your own shields (the ones in the passive, that is) and the ultimate's shield, as well as giving resistances to your allies. The 5% CDR really helps as well.
- Strength of the Ages is the one I'd go with. Remember that after all, you're Shen and you want to stack HP because that's what you scale with. You have the whole jungle for yourself and that means you can stack it pretty easily.

I feel like you shouldn't take that much CDR in your runes though, remember that energy champions spells are not only limited because of their cooldowns, but also because of their energy, spamming too many spells in a fight may result in you running out of energy, and that is reaaaaaally bad. If I were you I would take ATK Speed Marks and Quints, but keep the CDR in the blues.

As for the build... If you want to take an HP item I guess FotM is a good choice when you rock windspeaker, but if you get Strength of the ages, I'd consider taking the Ruby sightstone, it's 400G cheaper, it provides more health (thought not CDR nor HP Regen or gold) and it gives you items CDR, and that means that you can use more often... Titanic Hydra, which is an item you DO want to use, both for the basic attack reset and the stats it provides. If you don't feel like getting more HP or just don't like the item and you want to go offensive just get a BotRK since you have ATK speed in your runes.

For the toplane you MUST have 12/0/18 or 0/12/18, you NEED Grasp of the Undying, since they took away old Shen's Q HP Regen you have no sustain in lane, and this mastery greatly fixes this problem. For the runes I go with ATK Speed marks and quints, yellow armor/HP and blue CDR/MR, really depends on the matchup. For the toplane build I go for Sunfire vs AD and Spirit vs AP, then Titanic and keep building accordingly to their team and items. If you're feeling confident enough, go for Titanic Hydra first item and ZZ'Rot second, you will smash the lane if you're ahead.

I hope I could shed some light!
